title: CoAP token length not validated (max 8 bytes)
description:
File: rust/lichen-gateway/src/discovery.rs
Lines: 87-92, 98-103

BackboneDiscoveryRequest accepts arbitrary token length via token.to_vec() but CoAP spec (RFC 7252) limits tokens to 0-8 bytes. If CoapBuilder doesn't validate, oversized tokens silently produce malformed CoAP messages.

Edge case trigger: Caller passes 9+ byte token to new() or with_observe(). The TKL field (4 bits) can only encode 0-8.

Fix: Validate token.len() <= 8 in constructors. Either panic (caller bug per Rust conventions) or return Result<Self, TokenTooLong>.
